profile.headline: Software Engineer @ AdaptedMind | TIME Top EdTech Company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer at AdaptedMind, recently recognized as one of TIME Magazine’s Top EdTech Companies in 2026.
- Own high-traffic landing pages which drive the majority of user acquisition, supporting 3M+ visitors with over 50M interactions monthly
- Lead end-to-end UX/UI revamps across multiple product features, seamlessly integrating Responsive Design principles and industry best practices to enhance usability and user engagement
- Upgraded the frontend codebase to improve scalability and enhance performance, supporting a product that handles over 25M requests per day
- Own end-to-end frontend execution from low-fidelity concepts and high-fidelity Figma prototypes to production implementation and maintenance, consistently delivering polished, responsive, pixel-perfect user experiences
- Go-to team member for pixel-level UI debugging, visual QA, responsive design issues, and productionizing detailed design requirements
- Led AdaptedMind from zero QA automation to a fully automated test suite (Playwright, GitHub CI, BrowserStack), mobilizing engineering, QA and procurement to cut testing costs by 76%

positions.title: Software Engineering & Product Design Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted needfinding research and usability studies, wireframed, prototyped and implemented an interface in React Native to improve user experience operating semi-autonomous vehicles, with possibility of integration in future Ford vehicles
- Performance review showed “Exceed expectations” for all criteria

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built an internal tool with a developer-friendly UI to help autonomous vehicles navigate, ultimately validated this work on real autonomous vehicles
- Finished two additional projects on top of assigned intern project

honors.title: Design Contest Winner
honors.description: Voted as the winning t-shirt design out of 100+ submissions for Stanford's Code in Place program, reaching 20,000+ participants worldwide.
honors.issuer: Issued by Stanford University Code in Place · Jun 2025

honors.title: GHC '20 Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Department of Computer Science, Stanford University · Oct 2020

volunteerExperiences.role: Guest Speaker and Software Competition Judge
volunteerExperiences.companyName: U.S. Consulate General - Ho Chi Minh City
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Presented the history and practical applications of Artificial Intelligence, making complex concepts more accessible to a general audience at a sold-out event with a full turnout.
- Selected as one of two judges for a university programming competition, evaluating student-built software applications across technical competency, user interface design, and overall product execution.
